verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own scheduling: user-facing automations can produce status updates and performance reports "on a set schedule" (monday-docs-21), and the apps platform includes built-in cron alongside queues, logs and alerts on monday-managed infrastructure (monday-docs-45, monday-docs-5). Both are only one-line marketing claims, not detailed documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on schedule configuration (intervals, time zones, recurrence rules), explicit evidence that AI agents can be scheduled to run on a recurring basis, independent or hands-on corroboration.
